dedupe_keys.name: battery discharge characteristics for ieee 802 15 4 based radio load profile

description: Omer Ali and collaborators publish discharge experiments for batteries supplying IEEE 802.15.4 radio loads. The free Zenodo-hosted data archive carries the Dryad DOI 10.5061/dryad.g1jwstqr4 and CC0 rights. Experiments compare nickel-metal-hydride, lithium-polymer, lithium-ion and alkaline cells through conditioning, relaxation, capacity, open-circuit-voltage/state-of-charge and surface-temperature tests. Measurements are recorded every minute from full charge to discharge. These observations can calibrate battery-life components in simulations of wireless infrastructure sensors. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this four-chemistry collection. Coverage is specified cell models and laboratory radio-load profiles, so results do not establish lifetime for every duty cycle or installation temperature. Internal file encodings, repetitions and measurement uncertainty were not verified. The linked MIT code archive is separately licensed. No battery data or code archive was downloaded.
